<div class="review-text">
I had a lot of fun with this visual novel. The quality of delivery was very high, and I never felt frustrated by a lack of control fidelity or anxious about missing out on key parts of the story by not acknowledging all of the points it branches at.<br>
Overall, the story was pretty engaging and had some fairly lively characters. I don't feel like it did anything particularly revolutionary or that hasn't been done before, but it's executed so well that it felt like a brand new experience anyway. The content wasn't particularly saccharine or dark either, which might help it appeal to a broader audience.<br>
Overall, I'd recommend this to a lot of people, but not anybody who wasn't already familiar with hammy visual novels.
</div>
